name: APLD AI HPC Infrastructure Valuation
rationale: Applied Digital Corporation (APLD) is executing on ~1.41 GW of contracted critical IT load across five campuses, representing ~B in 15-year base lease value (~B with renewals). Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale, ND) has 175 MW live with anchor tenant CoreWeave; Polaris Forge 2 (Harwood, ND, ~280 MW) is on track for partial operations by year-end 2026. At ~.25, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of .76 (+26.6% upside at 9.72% WACC). Recent initiations from Wells Fargo ( PT) and Rothschild Redburn ( PT) bracket our valuation. Recommendation: MAINTAIN / ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 32.0 shares, 2.65% target weight). Accumulate on pullbacks near .50, trim Tier 1 at .76.

bear.rationale: Capex financing dilution; slower hyperscaler conversion; data center energization delays limit Year 5 revenue to $1.87B.
risks: Delays in grid power interconnect approvals and utility energization timelines
Capex overruns driving ongoing equity dilution (2.5% annual share inflation)

base.rationale: High-density AI cluster contracts scale to $3.9B revenue by Y5; achieving 16% net margin at scale with 22x exit multiple.
risks: Hyperscaler concentration risk across initial anchor tenants
Short-term margin compression during construction ramp phases

bull.rationale: Multi-gigawatt campus buildouts win major hyperscaler anchor leases; power interconnect moat commands premium cloud multiples.
risks: Grid interconnection regulatory caps in regional power authorities
Supply chain bottlenecks on liquid cooling and transformer equipment
